newsitem.title: USA: Farmers using crop loans despite high prices -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Farmers using crop loans despite high prices -USDA.

text.p: Farmers continue to make broad use of Agriculture Department crop loans despite comparatively high market prices, USDA officials said Tuesday.

Randy Weber, acting head of the Farm Service Agency, said loan volume was higher than one year ago. Prices have declined in recent months, he said, so farmers probably were using the loans for income while waiting to sell.
Acting Undersecretary Dallas Smith agreed, saying farmers were "parking" their crops in the low-interest loan program while riding out volatile prices.
